name: stable-compound-corner-speed-v1
clarification: The isolated compound class is tested directly; final bare routing is checked only after the preregistered dependent controller gates are composed.

scope.primary_change: impose one immediate 30-speed target cap only when a detected obstacle coincides with a curve already saturated at the stable controller's 36-speed floor

evidence.lineage_interpretation: The ZIP contents match the current runtime files, but no official receipt binds that ZIP to the videos; attribution remains a hypothesis.

videos.observation: The first exit occurs at an obstacle-adjacent sharp bend and is followed by approximately eight seconds without progress.

hypothesis.failure: The stable controller's standalone curve target floors at 36 while obstacle caps are 40 or 47, so an obstacle adds no longitudinal safety margin once a strong curve is visible. Target EMA further delays entry braking.
hypothesis.repair: After the existing target EMA, cap the target at 30 only for the conjunction of a detected obstacle and a curve target at the 36 floor. Preserve perception, steering, obstacle-side latch, target EMA, weights, and every non-conjunction action.
hypothesis.expected_effect: Create immediate braking margin for obstacle-adjacent sharp bends without changing steering or the previously completion-proven behavior outside that narrow compound hazard.

forbidden_inputs: top-down video converted into agent observations

synthetic: After four straight frames at speed 48, mirrored sharp curves with a detected near-apex obstacle produce gas=0 and brake>=0.20.
Candidate steering is bit-exact to the stable control and mirrored scenes have identical gas and brake.
Straight, obstacle-free curve, straight obstacle, lost-road, invalid-input, and reset actions are bit-exact to the stable control.
Actions remain finite, bounded, mutually exclusive in gas and brake, and deterministic after reset.
regression: The frozen stable-controller trace remains bit-exact.
Existing controller, inference, policy-routing, and package tests pass.

The compound controller is directly testable as an isolated stage; after dependent gates, bare state-dict routing selects the final subclass while DrQ, explicit exports, and HAIC paths remain unchanged.

abort: Any steering value changes relative to control.
Any action outside the compound-hazard predicate changes.
A second safety parameter is needed to pass the preregistered assertions.
Any frozen DrQ artifact, official environment file, reserved seed, model.pt, or user video changes.
Any relevant interface, package, or deterministic-reset test fails.
compliance_blockers: SOTA.md, RESULTS.md, COMPETITION_INFO.md, RESTRICTIONs.md, and report.pdf are absent.
The videos contain no raw 4x84x84 observations, actions, source receipt, collision telemetry, or official submission receipt.
No environment execution, submission, unseen-track claim, causal claim, or SOTA promotion is authorized.
